functions.purpose: Guild-task prerequisite/condition factory. functions.purpose: Full config-row reader for a CGuildTaskInfo (guild-task/legion-task definition). Reads id, localized Name/Note/Description strings, requirement fields, a task-content sub-object built from Content* args, and the full reward set. This recovers the complete CGuildTaskInfo struct layout (schema doc previously only had 0x20).
formulas: "Group" -> this+0x20 (int, task category/group; matches recovered typeOrCategory@0x20)
"PreTasks" -> list at this+0x34 via FUN_1162bea0 (prerequisite task ids)
content obj = FUN_11a02e50(&local_464); if nonzero push int into vector at this+0x48 (end ptr this+0x48, grows by 4; realloc via FUN_11a04c30 when full at this+0x4c)
"ItemsPrize1".."ItemsPrize5" -> parsed via FUN_11a030e0 into an item-reward list (appended, null-terminated, buffer at local_420/this)
costs: Reward columns per guild task: GuildExpPrize, GuildFundPrize, GuildReputePrize, GuildArenaPrize, GoldPrize, plus up to 5 ItemsPrize entries
Requirement columns: GuildLevel, GuildRepute, GuildArena, GuildPlot, PreTasks
Content sub-object holds ContentId, ContentType, ContentArg1..5 (7 ints, matches CGuildTaskInfo PlayerTaskEntryStride=7 in schema doc)
functions.serverRelevance: authoritative config — this is the guild-task definition the server must own: task requirements (guild level/repute/arena/plot, prerequisite tasks) and reward grants (guild exp/fund/repute/arena, gold, items). Server computes and grants these amounts on task completion; client only reads the table for display.
functions.notes: Struct offsets: id@0x10, Group/category@0x20, GuildLevel@0x24, GuildRepute@0x28, GuildArena@0x2c, GuildPlot@0x30, PreTasks list@0x34, ContentsType@0x40, content-obj vector@0x48/0x4c, GuildExpPrize@0x50, GuildFundPrize@0x54, GuildReputePrize@0x58, GuildArenaPrize@0x5c, GoldPrize@0x6c, ItemsPrize list appended after. Extends schema/docs/quest.md CGuildTaskInfo (was low-confidence, only 0x20 known).
